purpose: Fixed-checkpoint exploratory diagnosis of excess pixels outside SAM support; no training or benchmark promotion
geometry: Existing support-derived square crop with padding 2; interpolate logits before sigmoid; zero outside crop; preserve SAM support at one; threshold 0.5
probability_scores: Brier and clipped binary NLL over native pixels outside SAM support; mean per object then per image; NLL epsilon 1e-7
runtime: Pinned cluster environment on local RTX3060, FP32 Torch sigmoid, TF32 off, two CPU threads, one object per GPU pass, 20% GPU-memory cap; initial deterministic=False, adapted deterministic=True matching their reference arithmetic
selection: Report every fixed bias; no checkpoint, offset or inference policy is promoted
reference: Compare zero-bias native masks against original Quadro masks, reporting exact differences rather than assuming cross-GPU equivalence
interpretation: Reused exploratory validation, including earlier epoch selection; no untouched confirmation claim
